allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler, a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When multiple patients describe eerily similar nighttime traumas, can their testimony explain decades of vanished townsfolk?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In Nome, Alaska, decades of unsolved disappearances puzzle authorities. While treating local patients, psychologist Dr. Abigail Tyler uncovers disturbing evidence that connects the missing to extraterrestrial abductions.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful mystery demanding focused attention, best experienced alone in the dark.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Olatunde Osunsanmi weaves clinical therapy sessions with eerie sci-fi mystery, delivering a tense, unsettling thriller that reframes real-world missing-persons cases.
